description:
NotForm replaces the form with a conversation. You describe what you want to find out, the AI writes the questions and interviews each respondent in text or voice, and what comes back is not a loose transcript: it is structured data, field by field, ready to analyse.

With this connection that fits inside ChatGPT. Ask for a survey in plain language and get a shareable link back; come back later and read the collected answers without leaving the conversation, with the assistant summarising what came in.

Five tools are available: listar_pesquisas lists your surveys with how many answers each one has, and is where you start; ver_pesquisa shows the fields a survey collects and its response link; ler_respostas returns the structured answers, including who replied when the person identified themselves; listar_modelos offers ready-made templates for common cases such as NPS, team climate and post-support follow-up; and criar_pesquisa creates a survey from a plain-language objective or from one of those templates.

A NotForm account is required. The connection only ever sees the surveys of the person who authorised it, and reading and creating are granted as separate permissions on the approval screen.

defaultPrompt: Create a survey to find out why customers are cancelling, and give me the link to share
Summarise what people answered in my latest survey
Which of my surveys already have enough answers to analyse?
